February 19, 31.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your
letter of February 5, 1931, on the subject of
a Russian named I... Malkan, and to state that
there is nothing in the records of the Municipal
Police to the detriment of this man.

Malkan came to Shanghai in 1930 and
since then has been employed by the Messrs. Lor
and Lomach Chocolate Factory, No. 1... Great Western
Road. It was said at one period that he had
financial interests in the Shanghai United Club,
No. 306 Avenue Joffre, where, according to popular
report, gambling regularly took place. Previous
to coming to Shanghai, Malkan was a Commissar of
Soviet Fishery Establishments at Vladivostock.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches)

Encl: I ...
（签名）

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

（签名）

1931 年 2 月 19 日。

先生：

谨此提及您 1931 年 2 月 5 日关于一名
名为 I... Malkan 的俄国人的来信，并声明在
工部局警务处的档案中，没有任何对此人不利的记录。

Malkan 于 1930 年来到上海，
此后一直受雇于大西路（Great Western Road）1... 号的
Lor 和 Lomach 巧克力厂。曾有一段时间传言他在
霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）306 号的上海联合俱乐部（Shanghai United Club）
拥有经济利益，据坊间传闻，该处经常进行赌博活动。在
来到上海之前，Malkan 曾任海参崴（Vladivostock）苏联渔业机构的委员。

顺致崇高敬意，
先生，
您忠实的仆人，
（签名）
副总监
（刑事与特别股）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date February 16, 1931.
Subject (in full) I.M. Zalkan.
Made by D.S. Makaroff. Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter of
February 5, 1931 from the Consulate General for the Netherlands
concerning Mr. I.M. Zalkan, inquiries go to show that this
individual is engaged as the representative of the chocolate
factory of Messrs Lor & Lomach, 100 Great Western Road.
In 1917, shortly after the revolt in Russia,
I.M. Zalkan received the post of Commissar of the Soviet
Government Fishery establishments in Astrakhan. Later he
was transferred to various parts of U.S.S.R. with a view to
improving the work of similar establishments. In 1922 he
arrived in Vladivostok where he worked until 1929. While in
Vladivostok, he met Mr. Lor, owner of the above mentioned
chocolate factory on Great Western Road. In 1930 I.M. Zalkan
arrived in Shanghai and for some time had financial interests
in gambling conducted at the Shanghai United Club, 306
Avenue Foch.
There is nothing in S.M.P. records to his
detriment.
D. S. [Signature]
D. C. (C. & S. Branches)
Reg. Letter in accordance with
attached draft also signed by Mr Grey.
[Initials]
17.2.31.

主题（全称）：I.M. Zalkan。

先生，
关于随附的 1931 年 2 月 5 日荷兰总领事馆
有关 I.M. Zalkan 先生的来信，经查询显示，此人
受雇为大西路 100 号 Lor & Lomach 巧克力厂的代理人。
1917 年，即在俄国革命爆发后不久，
I.M. Zalkan 获得了阿斯特拉罕（Astrakhan）苏联政府
渔业机构委员的职位。后来，他被调往苏联各地，以改善
类似机构的工作。1922 年，他
抵达海参崴，并在那里工作至 1929 年。在海参崴期间，他结识了上述
大西路巧克力厂的业主 Lor 先生。1930 年，I.M. Zalkan
抵达上海，并在一段时间内对霞飞路（Avenue Foch）306 号
上海联合俱乐部进行的赌博活动拥有经济利益。
工部局警务处（S.M.P.）档案中没有任何对他不利的记录。
D. S. [签名]

AT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 389

SHANGHAI, 5th February 1931.

& S 1.200
S. L. D. 2002.
6 - 2 - 31.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that a certain Ilia Ilyevitch
Lalkin, member of the firm Far East Import Export Co., born
at Astrakhan 5 February 1876, living at No. 704, intends
to proceed to British India in order to purchase cocoa-beans,
necessary for the chocolate factory of
Tangsun Loonch, 150 Great Western Road, for which said firm
he holds sole rights.

Mr. Lalkin holds a passport issued to him by the Bureau of
Public Safety on 27 January 1931 No. 37.

He came to Shanghai in May 1930, having before that 5
years in Harbin, where he arrived via train from Vladivostock.

He states to have travelled in Europe before the war,
having then conducted a large fishery enterprise in Russia,
but had to remain in Russia during and after the war. He
did not serve in the army, having obtained exemption on account
of his services to the Russian Army.

After the revolution he travelled all over Russia, until
he finally arrived in Vladivostock in 1927 where he states to
have employed over a 100 workmen in his fishery business.
He states to have fled during the winter 1929/1930 on account
of his property being confiscated. He was married 6 years ago
to Eugenie Issaevna Krassnovsky, who is also in Shanghai.

He brought a letter of introduction from his firm, signed
by I. Kantzler, who lives at 427 Rue Cardinal Mercier, a house
inhabited e.g. by the brothers Patchowsky, agents of the U.S.S.R.

A certain Mr. A. Kogan, assistant manager of the Far Eastern
Import

R.C.Aiers, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Crime & Special Branches,

SHANGHAI.

电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第 389 号

上海，1931 年 2 月 5 日。

& S 1.200
S. L. D. 2002.
31 年 2 月 6 日。

先生：

谨此通知您，远东进出口公司（Far East Import Export Co.）的成员
Ilia Ilyevitch Lalkin，1876 年 2 月 5 日出生于阿斯特拉罕，现居住于 704 号，
拟前往英属印度购买可可豆，这些可可豆是
大西路 150 号 Tangsun Loonch 巧克力厂所必需的，该公司对该厂拥有独家经营权。

Lalkin 先生持有公共安全局（Bureau of Public Safety）于 1931 年 1 月 27 日签发的
第 37 号护照。

他于 1930 年 5 月来到上海，在此之前曾在哈尔滨居住 5 年，他是从海参崴乘火车抵达那里的。

他声称战前曾在欧洲旅行，当时在俄国经营一家大型渔业企业，
但在战争期间及战后不得不留在俄国。他
未在军队服役，因对俄国军队有贡献而获得豁免。

革命后，他游历了俄国各地，直到
1927 年最终抵达海参崴，他声称在那里雇佣了 100 多名工人从事渔业生意。
他声称因财产被没收而在 1929/1930 年冬季出逃。他于 6 年前与
Eugenie Issaevna Krassnovsky 结婚，她目前也在上海。

他带来了一封由其公司出具的推荐信，由居住在
梅尔西埃主教路（Rue Cardinal Mercier）427 号的 I. Kantzler 签署，该住所例如由 Patchowsky 兄弟居住，他们是苏联的代理人。

远东进口公司的助理经理 A. Kogan 先生

R.C.Aiers 先生，
警务处副总监，
刑事与特别股，

上海。
